sectors.name: Technology
themes: Indonesia's tech sector is increasingly driven by domestic digital-payment adoption and government-led financial inclusion, insulating it from US tech volatility.
AI-driven software monetization (ADBE, INTU) is re-rating US names, but Indonesia's value lies in localized SaaS and e-commerce logistics, not AI infrastructure.
Currency and rate differentials favor IDX tech: rupiah stability and Bank Indonesia's pause support local valuations, unlike US tech's sensitivity to Fed cuts.
sectors.ai: Buy the Indonesia tech dip selectively: local names (GPSO, MSKY) are holding up while US mega-cap software (ADBE, INTU) rebounds on AI monetization, but the -2.64% US drag signals rotation risk. Accumulate Indonesian digital-payment and SaaS leaders on weakness, as domestic demand is decoupled from US rate fears; trim US-exposed positions into strength.

sectors.name: Mining & Energy
themes: Indonesia's coal export competitiveness is structurally supported by low strip ratios and proximity to China/India demand, insulating margins despite global ESG pressure.
US LNG infrastructure expansion (TRGP, XOM) creates durable offtake demand for Indonesian gas, linking domestic upstream to global pricing floors.
Nickel downstream processing (ALKA) benefits from Indonesia's ore export ban, locking in domestic smelting margins as global stainless and EV battery demand recovers.
sectors.ai: Buy COAL on the coal-price floor and export-volume resilience; TRGP's LNG midstream leverage remains the top US-linked play for Indonesian gas flows. Rotate out of ITMA into ALKA for higher beta to nickel smelting margins. FPNI's +4.15% confirms thermal coal demand stickiness; hold XOM as a hedge against OPEC+ cuts.

sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's nickel downstreaming and EV battery integration drive durable demand for local renewables and climate-tech names like VKTR and CSAP.
US utility renewables (PCG, SRE, AWK) benefit from grid modernization and IRA subsidies, providing stable cash flows amid rate-cut uncertainty.
Policy tailwinds from Indonesia's energy transition roadmap and carbon trading scheme create structural upside for domestic climate-tech innovators.
sectors.ai: Buy dips in VKTR and CSAP on relative strength; trim EIX after its pop. US names (PCG, SRE, AWK) offer defensive carry but lag ID momentum. Rotate into Indonesian EV/battery supply chain names ahead of Q3 earnings. Maintain neutral aggregate exposure; signal NORMAL allows selective accumulation.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Protein and agri-commodity processors (BEEF, AGAR) are structurally benefiting from rising global food demand and Indonesia's protein consumption uptrend, driving sustained margin expansion.
Specialty chemical and packaging-linked FMCG suppliers (TFCO, BAUT) are gaining from downstream localization and import substitution policies, creating durable cost advantages.
Domestic staples face structural margin pressure from input cost inflation and weak purchasing power, favoring exporters and niche players with pricing power over mass-market names.
sectors.ai: Buy selective FMCG names with strong volume growth and margin expansion, as aggregate weakness masks robust single-stock momentum (BEEF, AGAR, TFCO). Favor exporters and raw-material beneficiaries over domestic staples; avoid laggards until IDX liquidity improves. Position for Q3 earnings beats in beef and agar-agar subsegments.

sectors.name: Entertainment, Media & Consumer Services
themes: Indonesia's digital-out-of-home (DOOH) advertising spend is structurally accelerating as urban infrastructure and 5G rollout expand, benefiting operators like DOOH with recurring revenue visibility.

Consumer services in Indonesia are shifting toward experience-based spending (cinemas, live events, theme parks) as middle-class disposable income rises, favoring TGUK and FORE over traditional media.
sectors.ai: Buy MDIA and DOOH on sharp re-rating momentum; both show volume-backed upside in a flat tape. Hold TGUK for follow-through but trim into strength. Avoid chasing SPOT at these levels. Rotate into SHID for defensive yield. Overall, stay selective—the sector lacks broad catalyst, so position in single-name stories only.

sectors.name: Property & Real Estate
themes: Jakarta MRT and toll-road extensions are structurally re-rating transit-oriented landbanks, favoring BSDE and PWON over peripheral developers.

Foreign capital rotation into IDX property is cyclical but sticky when IDR stabilizes; DUTI and BKSL benefit from office-to-residential conversion arbitrage as vacancy persists.

Position for 2H25 BI easing to re-rate asset values, but avoid chasing low-quality names. Trim on any 10%+ run without earnings confirmation.

sectors.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
themes: Indonesian retail crypto adoption is accelerating via local exchanges and P2P platforms, making domestically-traded tokens like BTW and PUMP structurally more liquid and prone to outsized rallies.
Regulatory clarity in Indonesia (Bappebti licensing) is gradually legitimizing digital assets, attracting institutional custody and payment partnerships that underpin long-term sector growth.
Global macro liquidity cycles — Fed rate cuts and USD weakness — remain the dominant driver of crypto beta, so Indonesian tokens will continue to amplify global moves rather than decouple.
sectors.ai: Rotate into high-beta Indonesian-linked tokens (BTW, PUMP) and liquid majors (HBAR, OKB) for momentum, but cap size — global crypto is in a WATCH regime with no ID-US split, so gains are sentiment-driven, not fundamental. Take partial profits on BTW's +61.7% spike; re-enter on pullback to 20-day EMA. Hedge with stablecoin pairs or reduce gross exposure if BTC fails to hold $60k.
